text: Spontaneous ejaculation, which is defined as the release of seminal fluids without apparent sexual stimulation, has been documented in boreoeutherian mammals. Here we report spontaneous ejaculation in a wild Indo-Pacific bottlenose dolphin ( Tursiops aduncus ), and present a video of this rare behavior. This is the first report of spontaneous ejaculation by an aquatic mammal, and the first video of this behavior in animals to be published in a scientific journal.
source_label: Spontaneous Ejaculation in a Wild Indo-Pacific Bottlenose Dolphin ( Tursiops aduncus )
